name: Pass without Trace

targets.description: you and creatures you choose while in the aura

summary: You and chosen creatures in a 30-ft Emanation get +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and leave no tracks.
text: A concealing aura fills a 30-foot Emanation around you for the duration. While in the aura, you and each creature you choose have a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and leave no tracks.
